title: Cosmic Pocket Watch
description: A ornate bronze pocket watch floats centrally against a dark cosmic background with radiating purple and teal light streaks. The watch face displays a glowing spiral galaxy surrounded by four glowing blue-purple nebulae shaped like abstract creatures, with zodiac symbols engraved around the dial.
prompt: An ornate bronze pocket watch floating in a dark cosmic void with radiating purple and teal light streaks. The circular dial contains a luminous spiral galaxy at its center, surrounded by four glowing blue-purple abstract nebula creatures. The outer rim is engraved with zodiac and alchemical symbols, with a small crown and three stars at the top. Mystical and surreal atmosphere with sparkling particles.
